name: nextjs-app-router
description: Next.js 14+ with App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, Prisma, and Tailwind

tasks.name: Project scaffold
tasks.description: Initialise Next.js 14 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and the App Router. Pin all dependency versions. Configure tsconfig paths and next.config for the project goals defined in PROJECT.md.

tasks.name: TypeScript types
tasks.description: Define all shared TypeScript interfaces and types for domain objects, API payloads, and form data based on the data model described in PROJECT.md.

tasks.name: Database schema and client
tasks.description: Write the Prisma schema for all entities. Export a singleton PrismaClient from lib/db.ts with connection pooling safe for Next.js hot reload.

tasks.name: Server Actions
tasks.description: Implement all Server Actions for create, read, update, and delete operations. Add input validation and typed return values for each action.

tasks.name: Auth setup
tasks.description: Configure NextAuth v5 with the providers specified in DECISIONS.md. Set up the middleware to protect routes. Export typed auth helpers.

tasks.name: Root layout and navigation
tasks.description: Build the root layout with metadata, global styles, and navigation component. Navigation must show authenticated user state using auth helpers.

tasks.name: Auth pages
tasks.description: Build the sign-in page using NextAuth signIn. Include form validation, error display, and redirect to the main page after successful login.

tasks.name: Core feature server component
tasks.description: Build the primary page as a Server Component. Fetch data directly using Prisma. Pass typed props to client components. Apply Tailwind layout.

tasks.name: Core feature client components
tasks.description: Build the interactive client components for the main feature. Use Server Actions for mutations. Optimistic updates where appropriate. No third-party state libraries.

tasks.name: Error and loading states
tasks.description: Add error boundary and loading skeleton components for root and main route segments. Error components must include a retry action.

tasks.name: API route handlers
tasks.description: Implement any REST API routes needed for external consumers or webhooks as defined in PROJECT.md. Validate auth on all protected routes.

tasks.name: Deploy config
tasks.description: Write .env.example listing all required environment variables with placeholder values. Add a deploy section to README.md covering environment setup and database migration steps.
